purpose: App icon: two overlapping rounded cards on a warm dawn gradient, one face down showing the concentric card-back pattern in #2E6F7E, one face up showing a #E0A32E star. Home Screen and App Store listing.
Light-mode game screen backdrop: vertical gradient #FDF6EC to #F0E2D2 with fine dithering so it never bands.
Dark-mode game screen backdrop: vertical gradient #1A1F26 to #0F1318 with fine dithering. Paired with background-light in one imageset via appearance variants.

Card-back pattern drawn in SwiftUI: flat #2E6F7E field (#3E8C9E dark) under three concentric continuous-rounded-rectangle strokes inset 8/15/22 pt at 22%/16%/10% opacity in #22545F. 14 pt continuous corner radius, 1.5 pt hairline. Scales to any card size.

Card face drawn in SwiftUI: #FFFFFF surface (#242B33 dark), one SF Symbol from the eight-symbol set at 52% of the card's shorter side, hierarchical rendering in its declared tint. Symbols and tints per ART.md.

The eight card symbols as an enum with SF Symbol name, light tint, dark tint, and VoiceOver label: star.fill #E0A32E, heart.fill #D2566B, bolt.fill #7B5EA7, leaf.fill #4C9A6A, moon.fill #5B7FB9, umbrella.fill #E0714F, anchor #2E6F7E, bell.fill #8C7A6B. Silhouettes chosen to stay distinct in greyscale.

Match celebration drawn in SwiftUI: spring scale 1.0 to 1.12 to 1.0 over 380 ms on both matched cards, plus 8 sparkle dots of 3 pt in #4C9A6A travelling 0 to 46 pt over 520 ms. Reduce Motion drops the scale and keeps a 240 ms fade.

Win confetti drawn in SwiftUI with TimelineView: 60 ribbons of 6x12 pt in #E0A32E, #E0714F and #2E6F7E, bursting and settling over 2000 ms behind the win overlay. Reduce Motion shows a static 400 ms fade-in instead.
Card flip: soft paper snap, ~120 ms, 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit. Filtered noise burst with a fast decay, no tonal pitch. Played on every flip via AVAudioPlayer on an ambient session.
Match: rising two-note chime, ~400 ms, 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit. Sine bells at E5 (659.3 Hz) then B5 (987.8 Hz), 60 ms apart, exponential decay.
Win: short major arpeggio, ~1.2 s, 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit. C5-E5-G5-C6 at 140 ms spacing, soft bell tone, tail ringing out to silence.
